text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~, as expected of you, Bubble-san! It 
was really, truly the best birthday 
ever~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course! After all, I made a 
"declaration"!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I swear I'll make Mayano's birthday the 
absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's amazing! You even managed 
to win the plushie Maya wanted!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How did you know? I didn't tell anyone I 
wanted this...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's simple. I just picked out things 
that I wanted for myself.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Look, we even go to the same knick-knack 
shop, so we have similar tastes anyway!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I just knew Mayano would totally love this 
kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy you put that much thought 
into it! Hey, hey, Maya wants to talk 
about more cute stuff with Bubble-san!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Want to come over to my room 
then? We can pick up some cake on the way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay, let's go, let's go! Oh yeah, can I 
bring Maya's favorite stuffed animal along 
too?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're more than welcome! Fufu, I'll have 
to mobilize all my little ones to give you 
a proper welcome.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're invited to the ultimate birthday 
party overflowing with cuteness!
